camel_example: aliyun live AddLiveAppSnapshotConfig --region cn-hangzhou --TimeInterval 5 --OssEndpoint 'cn-oss-0000.aliyuncs.com' --DomainName 'example.com' --OssBucket liveBucket0000 --AppName liveApp0000
description_en: Configures the snapshot feature for a streaming domain. The captured snapshots are stored in Object Storage Service (OSS). The configuration takes effect after you restart stream ingest
description_zh: 配置截图信息。输出内容保存到OSS中，重新推流即生效
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-app-snapshot-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --time-interval 5 --oss-endpoint cn-oss-0000.aliyuncs.com --oss-bucket liveBucket0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLiveAppSnapshotConfig

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. The value of this parameter must be the same as the application name in the ingest URL. Otherwise, the configuration does not take effect. The name can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (). The name cannot start with a hyphen (-) or underscore (). You can also specify an asterisk (*) as the value to match all applications
parameters.help_zh:
播流所属应用名称。
AppName名称与推流地址中的AppName名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The interval at which snapshots are captured. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 5 to 3600
parameters.help_zh: 截图周期，每个间隔周期截一次图片。单位：秒。取值范围：5~3600
parameters.name: time_interval

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of the OSS bucket.

After the configuration is complete, you can search for specific snapshots in the OSS console based on the callback information. You must configure the OSS endpoint in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储的Endpoint名称。

配置完成后，您可以根据配置回调信息，在OSS控制台查找指定的配置内容。OSS Endpoint需要提前创建，创建方法请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OSS bucket.

After the configuration is complete, you can search for specific snapshots in the OSS console based on the callback information. You must create the OSS bucket in advance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.help_zh:
OSS存储的Bucket名称。

配置完成后，您可以根据配置回调信息，在OSS控制台查找指定的配置内容。OSS Bucket需要提前创建，创建方法请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84932.html
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en:
The naming format of snapshots that are stored in the overwrite mode, which means that a new snapshot overwrites the previous snapshot.

The name must be less than 256 bytes in length.

Only JPG images are supported.

The name can contain variables such as {AppName} and {StreamName}
parameters.help_zh:
覆盖截图存储文件名。每次截图都覆盖此文件。

小于256 Byte。
目前仅支持生成JPG图片。
支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}
parameters.name: overwrite_oss_object

parameters.help_en:
The naming format of snapshots that are stored in sequence,

which means that a new snapshot does not overwrite the previous snapshot. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847902.html operation to query the snapshots that were captured within a specific time period.

The name must be less than 256 bytes in length.

Only JPG images are supported.

The name can contain variables such as {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}. The name must contain at least one of the {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} variables
parameters.help_zh:
实时截图存储文件名。

每次截图都递增存储，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2847902.html接口可以查询某一段时间的截图文件。

小于256 Byte。
目前仅支持生成JPG图片。
支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}，其中 {UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence} 必填一个
parameters.name: sequence_oss_object

parameters.help_en: The callback URL that is used to receive notifications about snapshot capture
parameters.name: callback
